primary.title: Relativity: The Special and the General Theory
primary.author: Albert Einstein
primary.rationale: Einstein's own explanation of his theories for a general audience. Likely to be available in digitized form.

primary.title: The Meaning of Relativity
primary.author: Albert Einstein
primary.rationale: A more technical exposition of his theories, based on lectures. A foundational text by the author.

primary.title: Ideas and Opinions
primary.author: Albert Einstein
primary.rationale: A collection of his essays and speeches covering a wide range of topics, offering insight into his thought process and public statements.

secondary.title: Einstein: His Life and Universe
secondary.author: Walter Isaacson
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive and widely acclaimed biography by a respected author, offering deep insights into Einstein's life and work.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Einstein

secondary.rationale: A collection of essays by leading scholars covering various aspects of Einstein's scientific and philosophical contributions.

secondary.title: Einstein and the Quantum: The Quest of the Magnetic Boy
secondary.author: A. Douglas Stone
secondary.rationale: Focuses on Einstein's crucial contributions to quantum theory, providing a scholarly analysis of a key area of his work.
